welcome.eyebrow: PRE-CONSULT CLINICAL INTAKE · OPD WAITING AREA
welcome.title: Your history, taken before the doctor calls you in.
welcome.description: Speak or tap in your own language. MediKiosk helps collect your medical history and documents before your consultation.

identify.title: Let's get you started
identify.description: Tell us a few basic details. You can type them or use the microphone.
identify.name: Your name
identify.nameHint: As you would like it recorded
identify.ageWheelHint: Swipe or scroll to change age
identify.aadhaarHelp: Enter all 12 digits. You can also say them aloud.
identify.aadhaarRequired: Please enter a valid 12-digit Aadhaar number.
identify.genderNotUnderstood: We couldn't understand that. Please say male, female, or other.
identify.ageNotUnderstood: We couldn't understand the age. Please say the number again.
identify.aadhaarIncomplete: Please say all 12 digits of your Aadhaar number.
identify.privacyNote: Your details are used only to prepare your consultation.

consent.title: Your consent
consent.description: Please review the information below and provide your consent before continuing.
consent.capture: I consent to MediKiosk collecting and recording the information I provide during this visit.
consent.sharing: I consent to sharing my information with the healthcare team for my consultation.
consent.notice: You can ask the healthcare team about how your information is used.
consent.required: Please accept both consent options before continuing.

interview.title: Tell us about your health
interview.description: You can speak naturally or enter your answer on the screen.
interview.privacy: Your responses are recorded as part of your clinical history.

questions.chiefComplaint: What is your main health problem today?
questions.symptoms: Please tell us about the symptoms you are experiencing.
questions.duration: How long have you been experiencing these symptoms?
questions.medications: Are you currently taking any medicines?

errors.answerRequired: Please provide an answer before continuing.
errors.voiceError: We couldn't understand your response. Please try again.

documents.title: Add your medical documents
documents.description: Upload prescriptions, lab reports, discharge summaries or other medical documents.
documents.documentType: What type of document are you adding?

processing.title: Preparing your clinical history
processing.description: Please wait while we organize your information.
processing.note: Please do not close or refresh this page.

confirmation.title: Your information is ready
confirmation.description: Your clinical history has been prepared for the healthcare team.
confirmation.note: You may now speak with your healthcare team.
confirmation.doctorInstruction: Please proceed to your assigned doctor for consultation.

mode.title: Choose your consultation mode
mode.description: Choose the consultation approach you would like to use for your health history.

allopathy.title: Allopathy
allopathy.description: Standard clinical history based on your symptoms and chief complaint.

ayush.title: Ayurveda / AYUSH
ayush.description: AYUSH-oriented history including Prakriti, Vikriti, Ahara, Vihara and related assessment fields.
